type Player @extends CharacterBody2D
    state:
        hp: int = 3
    rule TakeDamage by Player:
        when self.hp > 0
        then self.hp -= 1

type Player @extends CharacterBody2D
    state:
        speed: float = 300.4
        hp: int = 3
    rule Accel by Player:
        when self.hp > 0
        then self.speed += 5

type Hero @extends Node2D
    state:
        nickname: string = "hero"
        hp: int = 3

type Bullet @extends Area2D
    state:
        damage: int = 1

type Player @extends CharacterBody2D
    state:
        hp: int = 3

    rule OnHit by Bullet target Player:
        when target.hp > 0
        then target.hp -= 1, emit(hit)

type Player @extends CharacterBody2D
    state:
        hp: int = 10
    rule Heal by Player:
        when self.hp < 10
        then self.hp += 2
    rule TakeDamage by Player:
        when self.hp > 5
        then self.hp -= 1

type Player @extends CharacterBody2D
    state:
        speed: float = 100.0
        hp: int = 3
    rule Dash by Player:
        when self.hp > 0
        then self.speed += 25, emit(dash)
